This successive application has been filed under section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for anticipatory bail in connection with the complaint being I-C.R. No. 11216004200346 of 2020 registered with Dabhoda Police Station, Gandhinagar for offences punishable under sections 408,
420, 477(a), 120(b) and 114 of the IPC.

3. This Court has passed the following order on 23.01.2023:
R/CR.MA/2817/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/02/2023 "Learned advocate for the applicant seeks permission to withdraw present application.
The Permission, as sought for; stands granted.
Present application stands disposed of as withdrawn.
Interim relief, granted earlier shall stands vacated."

In view of the above, this Court has already dealt with all the submissions made on behalf of learned advocate for the applicant and this is successive application for anticipatory bail filed by the applicant and no fresh ground is made out to entertain present application.
Hence, I do not find any reason to entertain this successive anticipatory bail application of the applicant.
Hence, the present application is hereby rejected.
